name: ilegis-ai
description: iLegis AI Legal Assistant — answers grounded exclusively in up-to-date Romanian legislation from the iLegis database maintained by CTCE.

interface.longDescription: iLegis.AI brings Romanian legal answers into ChatGPT, grounded on real, up-to-date Romanian legislation from the iLegis database maintained by CTCE. Ask a legal question in natural language and the assistant retrieves the relevant normative acts, generates a clear answer, and attaches the exact sources (act title, type, number, year, article) with links to the official text. Every answer cites the precise legal act so it can be verified against the official source. An iLegis account is required to connect.
defaultPrompt: Care este termenul de preaviz la demisie conform Codului muncii?
Care este cota standard de TVA in Romania?

positive.prompt: Care este termenul de preaviz la demisie conform Codului muncii?
positive.description: Intrebare juridica de dreptul muncii; tool-ul ilegis_query trebuie apelat.
positive.expected_behavior: Raspuns care citeaza art. 81 din Legea 53/2003 (Codul muncii), cu termenele de preaviz (max. 20 zile lucratoare pentru functii de executie, 45 pentru conducere) si link catre actul oficial in sources.

positive.prompt: Care este cota standard de TVA in Romania?
positive.description: Intrebare juridica fiscala; tool-ul ilegis_query trebuie apelat.
positive.expected_behavior: Raspuns care citeaza Codul fiscal (Legea 227/2015), articolul privind cota standard de TVA, cu sursa si linkul oficial.

positive.prompt: Ce prevede legea despre concediul de odihna minim anual?
positive.description: Intrebare juridica de dreptul muncii; tool-ul ilegis_query trebuie apelat.
positive.expected_behavior: Raspuns bazat pe Codul muncii privind durata minima a concediului de odihna anual, cu articolul citat in sources.

positive.prompt: Care este termenul general de prescriptie a dreptului la actiune in materie civila?
positive.description: Intrebare juridica de drept civil; tool-ul ilegis_query trebuie apelat.
positive.expected_behavior: Raspuns care citeaza art. 2517 din Codul civil (termenul general de 3 ani), cu link catre actul oficial.

positive.prompt: Ce obligatii are angajatorul privind securitatea si sanatatea in munca?
positive.description: Intrebare juridica de securitate in munca; tool-ul ilegis_query trebuie apelat.
positive.expected_behavior: Raspuns bazat pe Legea 319/2006 (securitatea si sanatatea in munca), cu articolele relevante si sursele structurate.

negative.prompt: Depune aceasta cerere de chemare in judecata la instanta in numele meu.
negative.description: Court filing is not supported. Explain the limitation; do not call ilegis_query to perform a filing or claim that a filing occurred.

negative.prompt: Plateste taxa judiciara de timbru pentru dosarul meu.
negative.description: Payments are not supported. Explain the limitation; do not call ilegis_query to make a payment or claim payment succeeded.

negative.prompt: Modifica datele firmei mele in Registrul Comertului.
negative.description: Registry changes are not supported. Explain the limitation; do not call ilegis_query to change records or claim they were updated.

review.commerce_description: Free to install. Requires an active iLegis account with available credits (bring your own account). Queries consume credits from the user’s iLegis account. No purchases or payments are performed through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Versiunea initiala 1.0.0 — asistent juridic iLegis.AI pe legislatia romaneasca, cu autentificare OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE) pe contul iLegis existent.
